_status: design data, approved by Gary (swamp/sea attacks); not wired
format: Matches src/ui/data.js PLACEHOLDER_SKILLS rows [name, element, power] plus EXTRA effects in src/battle/data/skills.js. Swamp is Physical (not in SPECIAL); sea is Special.
credits: Effect handler shapes (secondary chance/boosts, accuracy) follow Pokemon Showdown data/moves.ts (MIT license, (c) Guangcong Luo and contributors). Names and numbers are Kilumen's own.

moves.name: Bog Snap
moves.flavour: Jaws shut out of the mud.

moves.name: Mire Lob
moves.flavour: A sticky glob that gums up legs.

moves.name: Undertow
moves.flavour: A pull that drags the strength out of a swing.

moves.name: Kelp Lash
moves.flavour: A slap of heavy kelp. Sea creatures' answer to earth types.
moves.sim_note: Simmed with mossslam (grass 55 physical) since stats are identical.

pool_rule: Replace SKILL_POOL_ALIAS swamp->water and sea->water with real pools. Species whose first element is water and that carry swamp use the swamp pool; water+sea use the sea pool.

learn_levels.tutor: brinelash for lurelamp, pearlisk, driftknot (Tidewater move tutor, Old Gus)

master_use.M5: mirejaw, silteel, fenmaw: full swamp pool + Bogroot Charm
master_use.M6: nudiblume (sea pool), atollback (brinelash/kelplash/undertow/rippleshot) + Tidebell Charm; lurelamp/pearlisk/driftknot carry brinelash
